keyMappings:
# Insert your preferred key mappings here.

# History
map <c-o> goBack
map <c-i> goForward

# Tab manipulation
map L nextTab
map H previousTab
map <space>bo closeOtherTabs
map <space>br closeTabsOnRight
map <space>bH moveTabLeft
map <space>bL moveTabRight

# Scrolling
map <c-u> scrollPageUp
map <c-d> scrollPageDown

# Resets
unmap J
unmap K
unmap u
unmap d
unmap b
